products.name: Folilock ADVANCE Hair Vitalizer Serum
products.subtitle: Folilock ADVANCE Hair Vitalizer Serum is an advanced anti-hair fall and hair regrowth formula designed to rejuvenate hair strands and boost healthy growth. Enriched with clinically proven hair growth actives including Capilia Longa™, Procapil™, Redensyl™, Anagain™, and Follicusan™, this serum helps stimulate hair follicles to enter an active hair growth phase. Free from added parabens and alcohol, it nourishes the scalp without leaving a sticky or heavy residue.
